premises: TaNbVTi-based RHEA can be fabricated by ball-milling and SPS with a ductile BCC matrix
Adding ~15 vol.% Al2O3 during powder processing leads to in situ formation of TiO precipitates
The TiO precipitates and dissolved Al provide combined precipitation and solid-solution strengthening
This intervention increases high-temperature yield strength by ~30% and reduces density by ~15%
Room-temperature ductility remains comparable to the undoped baseline
